newsitem.title: CHINA: China stock market said entering good phase.
newsitem.headline: China stock market said entering good phase.

text.p: China's securities market has entered a good phase this year because of more support from the government, the Shanghai Securities News quoted Yang Xianghai, president of the Shanghai Stock Exchange, as saying.

The central government has stated more clearly than ever that it supports the securities market and has taken concrete measures to stimulate its development, the newspaper on Tuesday quoted Yang as saying. It gave no details of the measures.
The Shanghai city government has also given special support to listed firms, Yang was quoted as telling a news conference on Monday.
He added that another good sign for the market was that the national economy was improving this year.
